$comment: Implements spec 03 §8.1 (report template blocks, page size and orientation, results-table columns, comment length limits). One template per document, matching reports/*.report.json in the pack layout (spec 03 §2.1).
title: Report card template
description: A template-driven report card rendered to HTML then PDF, with blocks in reading order (spec 03 §8.1).

levels.description: Levels the template is used for, for example G1 to G6 for a primary term report (spec 03 §2.1, §8.1).

blocks.description: Blocks rendered in this order (spec 03 §8.1). A runtime check rejects a template that repeats a single-instance block such as header or summary.

comment_max_length.description: Maximum length of a free-text comment under this template (spec 03 §8.2: length limits per template).

size.description: Paper size. A4 portrait is the default; A5 is an option (spec 03 §8.1).

orientation.description: Page orientation. portrait is the default; landscape is an option (spec 03 §8.1).

type.description: Block type from spec 03 §8.1. fees is optional and policy-controlled; verification carries a QR code linking to a signed verification URL.

label_key.description: Locale key for the block heading, resolved from the pack locale files (spec 03 §8.2).

columns.description: Configurable columns for a results_table (spec 03 §8.1). Other blocks ignore this property.
